$comment: Routes the app serves that no interaction reaches, each naming the feature that will reach it. `scripts/verify-reachability.mjs` fails on an orphan that is NOT listed here, AND on a listing that IS reachable or whose feature is already done — both directions, because a dead exemption is how a live one gets waved through later. Same shape and same reason as unreached-tokens.json (ADR-0088). THE WHOLE LIST PRINTS ON EVERY RUN: an exemption nobody reads is an exemption nobody weighs.
$readingComment: EMPTY FROM 2026-09-08 (F-180, F-181 and F-182 closed eight orphans) UNTIL 2026-10-20, when F-242 rebuilt Home to mockup 01. 01 draws no reading (ADR-0138), so Home's way into a reading's combinations went with the block that held it; the way 03 draws (Wear It, 03.actions.wear) is F-244's. An entry here is a promise with a date on it.

unreachable.why: A reading's combinations (24, C16). Home pushed it from its last-reading block, which ADR-0138 removed because 01 draws no reading and the block presented the newest colour row of any source as a measurement (F-337). The navigation 03 draws to it is Wear It on the Lens reading sheet (03.actions.wear), which F-244 builds; this entry fails the day F-244 closes with it still standing.
